title: Lower-screen Settings and shared confirmation dialogs
summary: Mirror live native Settings controls and their selectors. Present standard Yes/No and OK dialogs, including spellbook purchase, with the complete paged native message, item labels and named resource amounts. Execute original MainGUI callbacks under current owner, parent, revision and enabled-state checks.
preparation: Verify exact candidate receipt, package is.xyz.vcmi.thor and APK SHA-256; install preserving data. Prepare disposable saves for Adventure and Battle Settings, a Town with Mage Guild and a visiting hero without a spellbook, sufficient/insufficient gold, Blacksmith replacement and spell research if available. Record unavailable cases explicitly.
limitations: Keyboard/controller rebinding and its physical key-capture workflow remain on the upper screen. Custom selection/purchase windows outside standard CInfoWindow Yes/No or OK factories are not exposed by this shared adapter. Empty, invalid UTF-8, over-8192-byte dialog text, unnameable icon components and oversized settings lists fail closed; original upper controls remain authoritative. The ARM64 APK build requires CI; local host tests do not establish a physical pass.

checks.title: Complete Settings controls and live enabled state
checks.steps: Open Settings from Adventure and Battle. Page through General, Adventure and Battle controls, switching tabs below and above. Change music/sound in both directions to endpoints, nonlinear speed choices, toggles, and dependent controls such as large spellbook/animation. Compare live values and disabled states; check guest/battle Save/Load/Restart availability. Open Shortcuts on the upper screen, then return.
checks.expected: Every instantiated ordinary settings control is reachable on paged lower rows with its current native value/selection. Existing native callbacks apply each change once. Disabled controls and off-page/old targets cannot execute. Back returns to the correct Adventure/Battle context. Key binding capture stays upper-screen.

checks.title: Settings selectors, accept, cancel and display resize
checks.steps: Open scaling, long-touch duration and resolution selectors where available. Page all options below, select and accept once; repeat with cancel. Change selection using the upper screen between lower down/up. Test a resize/scaling change, then reopen Settings.
checks.expected: Current native options and selection match both screens. Accept applies the selected native option once; Cancel makes no change. Old revisions, changed selection and held releases are rejected. Resizing recreates the lower layout safely.

checks.title: Spellbook purchase Yes/No and rejection
checks.steps: Enter a built Mage Guild with a visiting owned hero without a spellbook. Compare the full question and item with the lower panel. Choose No and verify no gold/book change; reopen, choose Yes and verify the ordinary 500-gold purchase and Guild result. Try insufficient gold and an ineligible hero; dismiss the native notice below.
checks.expected: The complete question and item identity are visible below; Yes and No use the original native callbacks. Cancel does not spend resources. Accepted purchase follows server rules once and restores the correct Guild/Town. Error notices expose OK, without an unsupported purchase action.

checks.title: Settings, service and ordinary native dialogs
checks.steps: Cancel and accept Settings restart, main-menu return and quit in separate disposable runs. Test a Blacksmith replacement and spell research if available. Exercise other standard native Yes/No questions and queued OK notices, comparing resource names/amounts and item labels with the upper dialog. Page a long/localized message in both directions.
checks.expected: All standard factory dialogs show their complete bounded message and named component values; Yes/No or OK invokes the same native button as above. Queued notices bind to their eventual live parent. Native timing/server results remain unchanged; closing a child restores the correct live parent. Unsupported custom/oversized content safely withdraws actions.

checks.title: Stale, rapid and cross-screen input
checks.steps: Hold a lower confirmation, then close it above, switch to another dialog, or let a timed dialog expire before releasing. Rapidly tap Yes/OK, change a setting above during a lower press, switch Settings tabs while paging, and try multitouch/cancel/outside releases.
checks.expected: No release crosses owner, parent, revision, page or Presentation boundaries. At most one current native callback executes; no accidental next-dialog confirmation, duplicate purchase, stale setting change or stuck input.

checks.title: Lifecycle and upper-input regressions
checks.steps: While Settings, a selector and a spellbook/other confirmation are open, toggle the lower panel, background/resume, and detach/reconnect/recreate the secondary display where practical. Recheck upper touch/controller, main-menu confirmations, Town/Guild/Blacksmith restoration and normal single-display operation.
checks.expected: Exactly one current lower panel returns with correct text/actions and fresh gestures. No stale releases or focus theft. Upper input, existing build/menu confirmations and non-Thor behavior remain unchanged.
